g.text: B7 | Cross-section bypass and tangential surface-force direction
Both transverse panels use the same physical sampling locations and color range. Main flow travels in +x (out of these transverse panels).
Right: exposed-face centroids and unnormalized tangential traction vectors; pressure is not included in these arrows.
